source:
@@U02016@@
goes stark raving mad. Why do you do it? Why make common cause with us when you can’ stand the heat? You say you want to fly, and yet your head goes all dizzy. Did we make inroads on you, or you on us?

@@U02018@@
Don't bare your teeth at me! It disgusts me! Great and glorious Spirit who deigned to appear to me, you who know my heart and soul, why do you chain me to this abominable creature who feeds on misery and gluts himself on destruction?

@@U02020@@
Finished?

@@U02022@@
Save her, or be damned and suffer for ages!

@@U02024@@
What’s that? Loose the avenger’s chain's? Undo his bolts? I can’t! Powerless! “Save her!” Who was it destroyed her? You or I?
translation:
@@U02016@@
变得非常疯狂。你为什么这么做？当你受不了热的时候，为什么还要和我们一起共同奋斗呢？你说你想飞，但你的头却很晕。是我们侵犯了你，还是你侵犯了我们？

@@U02018@@
别对我露出牙齿！真让我恶心！伟大而光荣的圣灵，屈尊向我显现，你了解我的内心和灵魂，为什么你要把我束缚在这个以痛苦为食、以毁灭为食的可恶生物身上？

@@U02020@@
完成了吗？

@@U02022@@
救救她，否则就会被诅咒并受苦多年！

@@U02024@@
那是什么？松开复仇者的锁链？松开他的螺栓？我不能！无力！ “救救她！”到底是谁毁了她？你还是我？
